title: Hashcards card
description: One card as structured JSON, for tools and agents that would rather emit data than Markdown. It describes exactly one block of a deck file (CARD_FORMAT_SPEC.md, format v2); whatever writes it into the file turns it into metadata lines, Q:/A: or C:, and an optional Extra:. The parser stays the authority: this schema catches the common mistakes, not every one.

file.description: The deck file the card belongs in, relative to the collection root, with forward slashes. Created if it does not exist; its deck name then defaults to the file name.

type.description: basic: a question and an answer. cloze: one text with [bracketed] deletions, each of which becomes its own card.

id.description: The card's stable identity, written as its ID: line. Unique within the collection. Leave it out to have one stamped (8 characters of lowercase base32); pick a readable slug when the card has an obvious name.

question.description: Basic cards: the front, as Markdown. Becomes the Q: line and the lines after it.

answer.description: Basic cards: the back, as Markdown. Becomes the A: line and the lines after it.

text.description: Cloze cards: Markdown with at least one [deletion]. Brackets inside image syntax ![...] are not deletions; write \[ and \] for literal brackets.

extra.description: Either card type: a note shown only after the answer is revealed (context, a mnemonic, a pointer to the docs), as Markdown. Becomes the Extra: line and the lines after it, the last section of the card. Never part of the question, and changing it does not change the card's identity.

tags.description: Added to the deck file's frontmatter tags. Written as one comma-separated Tags: line. Lowercase letters, digits, '_' and '-', with '/' between levels of a hierarchy, as the parser normalises them: 'cka/type/syntax-pattern', not 'CKA::Type::Syntax Pattern'.

reverse.description: Basic cards only: also schedule the card answer-to-question, as Reverse: yes.

status.description: draft: proposed, not scheduled until accepted in the app's Inbox - what an agent should normally write. suspended: kept, not scheduled. active: scheduled; written as no Status: line at all.

side.description: Card text. Not blank, and no line after the first may start with Q:, A:, C: or Extra:, or be a --- separator: those would end the section early.

examples.question: What is the capital of Estonia?

examples.text: Change a Deployment's image: kubectl [set image] deploy/web [nginx=nginx:1.27]
examples.extra: The container name comes before `=`. Docs: *kubectl set image --help*
